name: io.github.tonyyang0504/arbeidsplassen-mcp
description: Arbeidsplassen (jobs): search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ARBEIDSPLASSEN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: JWT for NAV's job vacancy feed, sent as Authorization: Bearer. A rotating public token for experiments is served at GET https://pam-stilling-feed.nav.no/api/publicToken; a private one comes from nav.team.arbeidsplassen@nav.no after accepting the API terms (https://arbeidsplassen.nav.no/vilkar-api).
